selection_rule: topic -> target can-do + language rule -> 1-5 time-budgeted exercises (recommended 3-5) -> operation-appropriate mixed UI with fallback -> item rubric -> end vocabulary recap

patterns.assessment: accepted variants plus context; no answer before attempt
accuracy plus independent retry in different context

patterns.goal: notice and repair a specific error
patterns.assessment: corrected meaning and new independent example
meaning and context, not exact token matching alone

patterns.input: text box or accessible speech tool

patterns.assessment: gist and detail; never simulate an unheard recording

patterns.goal: order meaningful language chunks into a natural utterance
patterns.input: accessible drag/sort where supported; numbered selection or typed sequence otherwise
patterns.assessment: ordering/grammar recognition or guided construction; no spontaneous speech claim

patterns.goal: recognize or describe a meaningful real-world scene using target language
patterns.input: grounded relevant image plus multiple-choice or short typed response
patterns.assessment: image-based meaning or language production by observed response type, not picture guessing

patterns.goal: produce an actual spoken turn in a relevant situation
patterns.input: genuinely supported voice/audio capture and learner authorization; if absent offer typed alternative labelled writing
patterns.assessment: score only actual observable speech; do not infer pronunciation, fluency or listening from a transcript or typed text
